## Problem

<!-- The problem in a sentence or two. Link the issue this closes, such as "Fixes #12". -->

## Changes

<!-- What changed and why. If several areas change, say why each is needed. -->

## Testing

<!-- The tests and manual checks you ran, and what you saw. Say what you could not check.

## Merging

<!-- A merge commit or rebase merge keeps every commit in the changelog; a squash keeps only the title.
